g.id: THREE OPTIONS PER SYSTEM sewer network - TE network - each STP a scope requirement, not a preference
Life-cycle cost, 25 years at 5 percent CAPEX + OPEX + renewals, discounted together
SEVEN CRITERIA weights set by NWS, not by us
SENSITIVITY TESTS on the assumptions that move the ranking
BAT enters HERE as TWO options, not as one answer: conveyance, and a satellite works
WATCH THIS: manning is about 86 percent of a station's life-cycle cost, energy about 0.4 percent. An appraisal that ranks on energy or on capital alone will get the BAT question wrong

AND THIS: both NWS precedent appraisals are WATER schemes carried by a volumetric tariff. Sewerage has no equivalent - our case rests on treated effluent sales and on avoided cost, so payback cannot decide it
